item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 27/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The anticyclone aloft will continue to bring mainly fine weather to Guangdong today, but high temperatures will also trigger showers over inland areas. An upper-air disturbance will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China tomorrow. A tropical cyclone is expected to form over east of Luzon Strait and move towards the vicinity of Taiwan to the East China Sea early next week. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will be very hot over southern China. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will reach Guangdong on Tuesday. The weather will be mainly fine, slightly cooler and dry over the region in the middle and latter parts of next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
